29.name: Sealing Wax
29.why: Pressed into warm wax, this deep, glossy red is the mark that says whose work this is.

29.name: Velvet Drape
29.why: I think of the heavy curtain on a shared stage: deep, generous, and open for everyone to see.

29.name: Banked Embers
29.why: Banking the fire overnight so the next person can light their own from it is how I think of sharing.

30.name: Paper Lantern
30.why: Lit from within, it gives this same soft coral glow to a room anyone can walk into.

30.name: Sunlit Plaster
30.why: A warm wall in late sun turns this soft coral, like the old walls where many hands have left their marks.

30.name: Torchlight
30.why: Passed hand to hand so every traveler sees the road, the way open work lights the path for those who follow.
